entities.summary: Adolf Holtzmann was a German professor and philologist. His name is associated with a Proto-Germanic sound law known as Holtzmann's law. Adolf Holtzmann was a physicians & medical pioneers from Karlsruhe (1810-05-02, Karlsruhe–1870-07-03). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
